notes.title: The Great Coffee Caper Demo - 1.02 - Update
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Hello!
We have more changes for you all! These are primarily 3 big changes with a few small bug fixes sprinkled in.

BUT FIRST!
Dearest reader!

Do you have a need, a desire, a DEMAND for the wonderful music of The Great Coffee Caper?

Look no further dear reader!

Music from The Great Coffee Caper Demo is available on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, and MORE!

 YouTube

Streaming Services
[previewyoutube="g0LPhIHLhfw;full"][/previewyoutube]

WHAT'S THAT DEAR READER!?YOU WANT EVEN MORE!!??[p align="start"]Well, your search is over!

The full soundtrack of the demo is available for purchase on Steam and Bandcamp!

Purchasing the soundtrack on Steam also gives you free updates to any new music added in the future!

Steam

Bandcamp


EVEN MORE!!!???
FINE!

For you, dear reader, I suppose I must...

If you enjoy the music of The Great Coffee Caper, the original soundtrack's composer, Zectro, published a video showing a behind-the-scenes look!
[previewyoutube="xnpAhO3rgf0;full"][/previewyoutube]


...

Ok, that's all for now, be thankful!

Version 1.02:
A certain attack of the Big Spark battle has been adjusted

The Big Spark's health has been increased

The Spark Glass's hitbox has been shrunk

Flavor text has been added to Cup O Joe

Fixed interactions outside of Cup O Joe

Charlie no longer walks on water, he now walks on grass like any other self-respecting mouse

A new, more legible font option has been added

You can now choose between "Classic" font and "Clean" font when you first start up the game 


[p align="start"]Never fear! More changes are in the works!
[p align="start"]Planned changes:
[p align="start"]Big changes to regular battles to make them more difficult and intriguing

Ability to change font in settings menu

Small bug fixes
[p align="start"]If you find any issues or anything that seems odd, you can let us know in the Community Hub or in our Discord!
[p align="start"]
Final Thoughts
Thank you all so much for your support of the game! To God be the glory.

We enjoy seeing all of your playthroughs online as well!

There is one more big hurdle for updates to the demo, regular battles, but after that, updates will slow unless they are absolutely critical. This is so development can begin on the full game!

Once again, thank you. Happy playing!


[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Stay up to date!
[p align="start"]Discord: 

https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6
[p align="start"]X: 

https://x.com/EverydayMagicX
[p align="start"]

notes.title: The Great Coffee Caper Demo - 1.01 - Update
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you to everyone who has played the demo! We love seeing you all are enjoying it!

There are a number of changes and small improvements to the demo to make your experience more enjoyable. These are small bug fixes that will make your gameplay more consistent.


Version 1.01:

Fixed an issue where you could leave Clawdine's house before getting the hammer

The game now autosaves after certain cutscenes

Fixed certain sprites not displaying properly

Hootsworth now moves to a proper location in the closet

Clawdine will stop being rude when you talk to her

Fixed an issue where certain interactions would commence when not intended

Removed the ability to access debug features

Fixed typos in dialogue

Certain interactions should be easier to commence

Added furniture in Charlie's room



Never fear! More changes are in the works!

Planned changes:

A new and more legible, font option. You will have the option to choose between the current "Classic" font and the new "Clean" font

A certain attack of the Big Spark is going to be tweaked to be more fair

Charlie's movements will be more consistent

no more walking on water :(

And more!



Thank you for your patience!

If you find any issues or anything that seems odd, you can let us know in the Community Hub or in our Discord!




[p align="start"]Stay up to date!
[p align="start"]Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Xj5p8VbTD6
[p align="start"]X: https://x.com/EverydayMagicX
[p align="start"]

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just wanted to give a quick update about development.


We are currently working on a short demo for you all, and are getting closer each day to completing it. Here is a short list of things that need to be done:

Finish up one more cutscene

Boss battle

Sound design

Bug fixing

Some of these things (like the cutscene) are quicker to complete then others, and so I hope that it won't be too much longer until you all can play something. 

Thank you so much for your patience. This is our first game and so we never REALLY know how long something is going to take.

That's all for now! Hope to have more to share soon!



Stay up to date!

notes.title: 10,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507537/e8c99ee2da8a367b6a486d4725b5d195e8f0f2dd.png"]10,000 Wishlists!


This is an incredible milestone that we never expected hitting so soon!

This time last week, we had a little over 670 wishlists. To jump up to 10,000 so quickly is breathtaking and incredible!

We are so incredibly thankful for the support we have received! Thank you to God and thank you to you! 

A short demo of the game is coming soon and is our top priority at the moment. We'll let you know as soon as it releases.

Once again, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!!!

If you want to get all of the latest news and chat with the community, join our Discord and follow us on Twitter/X
